ANOTHER OCCURRENCE — CI run 31349549323 (Gerrit change 1577 patch set 4, ubuntu-latest/py3.13):
  FAILED tests/interfaces/store/test_git_contention_9305.py::test_concurrent_processes_through_seam_both_succeed
  AssertionError: writer alpha failed ... assert r.returncode == 0

Confirmed flake, not a regression: PASSES locally on that exact tree, and the change under
test (85fa) touches only fsck_repair/fsck_restore — nowhere near the write seam.

Notable: bug 168e (s3_doctor 'fatal: bad object HEAD' while bundling the merged tip) failed in
the SAME CI run on a different Python cell. Two store/git concurrency flakes surfacing
together suggests a shared trigger in how the runners schedule these tiers, rather than two
independent races. Worth investigating together.

Cost: this pair produced a spurious Verified -1 that took a full triage cycle to attribute.
